# Bitcoin Roatán

> A neutral, practical guide to using Bitcoin on Roatán island, Honduras — merchants, ATMs, community, and resources. No hype, just facts.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Coming soon landing page with a curated marketplace of Bitcoin projects on the island.
- [Hub](/hub): Main hub linking to all guide sections.
- [Why Bitcoin](/why): Why Bitcoin matters and how it fits Roatán.
- [Use Bitcoin](/use): Practical guide — wallets, ATMs, merchants, getting started.
- [What's Up](/whatsup): Current events, community links, and what's happening now.
- [About](/about): About the project and partners.
